messages:
Kai Lee: Heads-up — I just realized I'm in transit tomorrow and won't have a laptop for the 00:00-08:00 UTC shift (holiday travel). I can keep phone on but can't join bridges or run CLI fixes. There's a blindspot between EU primary and APAC secondary overnight. Can someone pick up primary or shadow? Sorry for the last-minute ask.

Priya Sharma: Ack. what's current assignment right now? who is primary/secondary?

incident-bot: Scheduled on-call for 2025-12-24: Primary: Kai Lee (eu-night), Secondary: Priya Sharma (apac-night).

Kai Lee: To be explicit — I can try to respond by phone for low-severity pings, but I can't drive a bridge or run `kubectl` changes. Need full coverage.

Mateo Rivera: I can take primary for the first half (00:00-04:00 UTC) if someone can cover 04:00-08:00. I'm local and can access consoles.

Sam O'Connor: I can take 04:00-08:00 UTC and act as primary then. @Mateo let's hand off at ~03:50 UTC.

Priya Sharma: Adding runbook links — please keep them handy: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/holiday-bridge and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pg-latency. Quick triage checklist: 1) Console > Routes > check p50/p95/p99 latency and 5xx rate, 2) status page `status.redwood.prod`, 3) `kubectl logs -n inference model-worker-*` for OOMs/tracebacks.

Jordan Kim: If you need to flip fallback routing: only infra or oncall with perms should run: `redwoodctl route set --policy fallback-variant --env prod`. Ping me if you want me to run it — I'll be available on call.

Mateo Rivera: I'll do a preemptive cache flush at 23:58 UTC: `redwoodctl cache flush --prefix /kv/default`. Also note a flaky node pool we've seen: `gpu-eu-pool-2` — if you see OOMs, reassign to `gpu-eu-pool-1`. Script is in ops-scripts.

incident-bot: Reminder: if you accept handoff, mark yourself as Primary in PagerDuty and post a confirmation here.

Mateo Rivera: Marked primary in PD for 00:00-04:00 UTC. I'm reachable on phone and Zoom, will open bridge if I can't triage within 10m.

Sam O'Connor: Marked secondary in PD for 00:00-08:00 UTC. I'll act as primary from 04:00-08:00 and take the bridge. Contact: sms/cell.

Kai Lee: Handoff notes I'm leaving: watch `gpu-eu-pool-2` for node churn & preemption; the autoscaler sometimes under-reacts to tail p99 bursts. Useful checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep model-worker`, `kubectl top pods` (if metrics available). Customer-facing metrics: increase in 5xx or dropped streams under Routes > /generate.

Priya Sharma: If you see 5xx spike do this order: a) scale model workers: `kubectl scale deploy model-worker --replicas=6 -n inference`, b) enable fallback routing if scaling doesn't bring p95 down, c) open bridge and @infra. If you need infra to run the route flip ping @Jordan.

00:12 UTC — Sam O'Connor: FYI got a pager — intermittent 502s affecting a subset of customers. I'm going to pull logs and hold a 10m bridge if it persists.

00:14 UTC — Mateo Rivera: I'm seeing p99 tail latency spike on probe 63 (prometheus) and several model-worker pods restarting with OOMKilled. Collecting logs now.

00:15 UTC — Sam O'Connor: Opening bridge: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (pw: redwood). Inviting infra, infra-oncall, and product-sre.

00:18 UTC — Jordan Kim: On the bridge, checking autoscaler events and node lifecycle. Looks like two EU preemptible nodes were reclaimed at once causing churn and pod restarts. Infra can evict pods and spin new nodes. Suggest enabling fallback routing temporarily.

00:22 UTC — Sam O'Connor: Enabled `fallback-variant` (via Jordan). Observed 502 rate dropping. Continuing to monitor.

00:30 UTC — Mateo Rivera: I pushed a targeted scale to model-worker to 6 replicas. Heap OOMs decreased and p99 dropped. Monitoring metrics now.

03:52 UTC — Mateo Rivera: Handoff to Sam in thread: I'm handing primary to Sam; logs and brief notes already on the bridge. All critical alerts suppressed, p99 trending down.

04:05 UTC — Sam O'Connor: Confirming handoff accepted. I'm primary now (marked in PD). Current status: node churn mitigated, fallback routing still enabled as a safety net. No customer data loss, intermittent 502s reduced to baseline. I'll keep monitoring until 08:00 UTC then post final signout.

07:58 UTC — Sam O'Connor: Final update before signout: system stable, autoscaler adjustments held, rolling node replacements completed. I'll file a post-incident note in #incidents and link runbook changes. Signing out at 08:00. Thanks everyone for the quick responses. :thumbsup:
